title: mai's colorful toolboxes (for Create)
description: a resource pack that makes Create's toolboxes a little bit more colorful, brighter, and easier to distinguish!
body:
Has this ever happened to you? You're playing with the lovely Create mod, using its handy 'Toolboxes' for organization and such, but... gosh, brown and red toolboxes are so simillar. i just can't seem to tell them apart.. oh no.. my chests will remain unparseable forever...


Well... fear no longer!! for i have made a resource pack which attempts to help with this very dillemma!!
witness my raw power!!!!

![Before & After! - Comparison between Default & my recolors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4519806934ad5e7d6dd8d5b6be9b75f100b1584.png)
